integrity: The formula is proved by an explicit analysis of rooted truncations of the universal cover, with direct finite replay of the refinement process over a broad parameter range.
scientific limitations: Only ordinary one-dimensional color refinement from the uniform coloring is treated.
The theorem covers tadpole graphs, not arbitrary unicyclic graphs.
The finite checker is corroborative and does not replace the all-parameter proof.
title: Exact color-refinement depth of tadpole graphs
